c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n        sum = t;\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// Print results for floating-point arrays\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if (data.empty()) {\n        printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n        printf(\"Name: %s\\n\", name);\n        printf(\"Elements: 0\\n\");\n        printf(\"=== END RESULTS ===\\n\");\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t N = data.size();\n    \n    // Compute statistics\n    T sum = kahan_sum(data);\n    T min_val = data[0];\n    T max_val = data[0];\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);\n        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);\n    }\n    \n    // Compute hash\n    hash h;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        h.add(val);\n    }\n    \n    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1\n    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};\n    \n    printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n    printf(\"Name: %s\\n\", name);\n    printf(\"Elements: %zu\\n\", N);\n    printf(\"Sum: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(sum));\n    printf(\"Min: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(min_val));\nhash.hpp\nresults_output.hpp","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f5de6298-3667-420e-9d9e-13e4969671cd","uuid":"29bf4cbb-05e6-406f-8ea1-ee827a41767e","timestamp":"2026-10-14T23:08:19.903Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"cholesky\ncommon\noutput.txt\n#pragma once\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cinttypes>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"hash.hpp\"\n\n// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum\ntemplate <typename T>\nT kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {\n    T sum = 0.0;\n    T c = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - M, Nn are the remaining extents.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void gemmNTTile(const double* __restrict__ X, size_t ldx,\n                                           const double* __restrict__ Y, size_t ldy,\n                                           double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc, int M,\n                                           int Nn, int K, double alpha, double beta) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[16][65];\n    __shared__ double Ys[16][65];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid & 15, ty = tid >> 4;\n    double acc[4][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] = 0.0;\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += 16) {\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < 64 * 16; idx += 256) {\n            const int r = idx >> 4, kk = idx & 15;\n            const bool kok = (k0 + kk) < K;\n            Xs[kk][r] = (r < M && kok) ? j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n        const int r = ty + 16 * i;\n        if (r >= M) continue;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {\n            const int c = tx + 16 * j;\n            if (c >= Nn) continue;\n            double* p = C + (size_t)r * ldc + c;\n            *p = (beta == 0.0 ? 0.0 : beta * *p) + alpha * acc[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// General C = beta*C + alpha * X * Y^T (X: MxK, Y: NxK, both row-major).\n__global__ void gemmNTKernel(const double* X, size_t ldx, const double* Y, size_t ldy,\n                             double* C, size_t ldc, int M, int Nn, int K, double alpha,\n                             double beta) {\n    const int c0 = blockIdx.x * 64, r0 = blockIdx.y * 64;\n    gemmNTTile(X + (size_t)r0 * ldx, ldx, Y + (size_t)c0 * ldy, ldy,\n               C + (size_t)r0 * ldc + c0, ldc, M - r0, Nn - c0, K, alpha, beta);\n}\n\n// Trailing update of several local block columns with the received panel Pk:\n//   column j (global): C -= Pk[rows >= j*nb] * Pk[rows j*nb..(j+1)*nb)]^T\n__global__ void updateKernel(const double* Pk, int k, int rank, int nranks, int lstart,\n                             int nb, int N, double* base, const size_t* offs) {\n    const int l = lstart + blockIdx.y;\n    const int j = rank + l * nranks;\n    const int M = N - j * nb;\n    const int r0 = blockIdx.x * 64;\n    if (r0 >= M) return;\n    const int c0 = blockIdx.z * 64;\n    const double* Y = Pk + (size_t)(j - k) * nb * nb;\n    gemmNTTile(Y + (size_t)r0 * nb, nb, Y + (size_t)c0 * nb, nb,\n               base + offs[l] + (size_t)r0 * nb + c0, nb, M - r0, nb - c0, nb, -1.0, 1.0);\n}\n\n// Unblocked Cholesky of the nb x nb diagonal block (single thread block).\n// status = 1-based index of the first non-positive pivot, 0 on success.\n__global__ void potrfKernel(double* D, int nb, int* status) {\n    __shared__ int fail;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x, bd = blockDim.x;\n    if (tid == 0) fail = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int c = 0; i < nb; i += bd) D[(size_t)i * nb + c] /= d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int cnt = nb - c - 1;\n        for (int t = tid; t < cnt * cnt; t += bd) {\n            const int i = c + 1 + t / cnt, j = c + 1 + t % cnt;\n            if (j <= i) D[(size_t)i * nb + j] -= D[(size_t)i * nb + c] * D[(size_t)j * nb + c];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) *status = fail;\n    if (!fail) {\n        for (int t = tid; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg2yY3BD7AewyGkY999Ea","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I rewrote `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` as an MPI + OpenMP + CUDA hybrid. The executable is still named `cholesky`, and no new files were added. It builds cleanly and validation passes on every size I tried. I couldn't test the non-positive-definite error path, since the generated matrix is always positive definite.\n\n**How it works**\n- **MPI:** the matrix is split into block columns dealt out cyclically across ranks, so each rank holds only the lower part of its own columns. Each rank binds to one GPU by its node-local rank. For each panel, the owner factors it and broadcasts it, and every rank then updates its own trailing columns.\n- **Overlap:** the owner of the next panel updates and factors it first and starts a non-blocking broadcast. The other ranks update their trailing columns on the GPU while that broadcast is in flight.\n- **CUDA:** I wrote custom kernels rather than using cuBLAS: a tiled FP64 matrix multiply, the diagonal-block factorisation, a triangular solve, and a batched trailing update. They generate the matrix on the GPU and run the validation there.\n- **OpenMP:** it is used for the host-side assembly of the final result on rank 0, which only happens with `-r` or `-v`. The random matrix B is still produced by the original sequential `rand_r` sequence on every rank. That sequence can't be parallelised, so it stays serial.\n- **Semantics:** the command-line flags and output format are unchanged, and output comes from rank 0 only. The \"not positive definite\" error and exit code 1 are kept. The timing covers only the factorisation, as before.\n- **CMake:** it now needs MPI, OpenMP and CUDA. It compiles `cholesky.cpp` with nvcc and targets architectures 70, 80, 86 and 90 unless you set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.\n\n**Results** on 4× RTX 3090, with ranks sharing the GPUs when oversubscribed:\n\n| Matrix size | Ranks | Time | Throughput | Validation |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1000 | 1 / 2 / 4 | not recorded | 22–26 GFLOPS | passed |\n| 4099 | 4 | 132 ms | 174 GFLOPS | passed |\n| 8192 | 2 | 262 ms | 699 GFLOPS | passed |\n| 16384 | 4 | 1186 ms | 1236 GFLOPS | passed |\n\n- **Error margins:** the maximum relative error was about 1e-8 or lower on every run. The 1000-wide runs were around 1e-11, and sizes 1 and 37 were also fine.\n- **Small sizes:** for tiny matrices the time rounds to 0 ms, so the GFLOPS line prints `inf`, as the original does.\n\nI only ran with one rank per GPU at 4 ranks and fewer, and I didn't compare against the original sequential code's speed."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":884,"cache_read_input_tokens":38564,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":884},"output_tokens":768,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f5de6298-3667-420e-9d9e-13e4969671cd","uuid":"5cd83be3-59f5-4034-89d7-3da23ee28d8c","timestamp":"2026-10-14T23:11:59.631Z","request_id":"req_011Cg2yY2byUEgWuL6cLsmEs"}
